_doc: Generated by tools/generate_bank_versions.py from a -DBUILD_TUNING=ON build; do not edit by hand. Each unit is a voice, a drum note or a group of shared calibration constants, carrying the generation it is on, a fingerprint of its values and the history of its bumps. `make bank-versions-check` fails when a unit's values have moved without its version following. It fingerprints values only: an edit to an engine's code moves nothing here, and the synth golden manifests under tests/midi/golden/ are what catch that. The values are here so the diff of a bump says what moved.
